# Pawthereum's First Onchain Donation: $100 to Lovable Paws Rescue
metadata.description:
# Pawthereum's First Onchain Donation: $100 to Lovable Paws Rescue
![Lovable Paws](https://static.tally.xyz/dbb043d6-46c3-4280-b922-d5d56d887e8d_original.png "Lovable")

Lovable Paws Rescue is a non-profit animal sanctuary and adoption center located in Ridgeland, South Carolina. They are dedicated to rescuing neglected, abused, and unwanted animals, providing them with proper care, and finding them loving forever homes. Here are a few compelling reasons why you should consider voting For a donation of $100 to support their noble cause:

## Providing Vital Care for Rescued Animals

The average cost of housing a dog for a month at Lovable Paws Rescue is $175. A $100 donation can significantly contribute to covering the expenses of food, medical care, and shelter for multiple rescued animals awaiting adoption. This ensures that these vulnerable animals receive the necessary attention and care they deserve.

## Facilitating Successful Adoptions

Lovable Paws Rescue thoroughly vets potential adopters to ensure each animal finds the perfect forever home. Your donation supports their efforts in carefully matching rescued animals with compatible families, increasing the chances of successful and lasting adoptions.

## Supporting a Dedicated Team

Lovable Paws Rescue is run by a passionate team of volunteers who tirelessly work to fulfill their mission of helping neglected and abused animals. Your donation not only aids the animals but also supports the individuals who selflessly dedicate their time and efforts to this cause. Alex, one of the members of the shelter, runs a crypto morning show called the Rise Up Morning show!

## Pawthereum's First Onchain Vote

Participate in our first onchain governance vote! Historically, Pawthereum has used offchain voting mechanisms like Snapshot to avoid hefty Ethereum mainnet gas fees that would be carried out by a multisig of passionate Pawtherians. Now that the project has migrated to Base, we can become even more decentralized by executing transactions trustlessly with our new onchain DAO contract! This original amount is purposefully small so that we can test our onchain governance system. In the future, we plan to have our onchain governance contract collect funds automatically!
